lines.text: Product of primes, HCF or LCM, including when two repeating events next happen together → factor tree; HCF: shared primes at the lower power (none shared: $1$); LCM: every prime at the higher power ({{lesson:1.1}})
Venn diagram with totals, how many are in both → $n(A \cap B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cup B)$, where $n(A \cup B)$ is $n(\mathscr{E})$ minus those in neither; fill the overlap first ({{lesson:1.2}})
Put fractions, decimals and percentages in order → change all to decimals with the same number of places (at least $3$), order them, then write the numbers as given ({{lesson:1.5}})
Bounds of a rounded value → value $\pm$ half the rounding unit, written lower bound $\leqslant x <$ upper bound ({{lesson:1.10}})

Upper bound of a calculation with positive rounded values → $a + b$ and $a \times b$: both upper bounds; $a - b$ and $a \div b$: upper $a$, lower $b$. Swap every bound for the lower bound ({{lesson:1.10}})
Share in a ratio, or one share or a difference is given → find one part: that amount $\div$ its number of parts, then multiply by each number in the ratio ({{lesson:1.11}})
Average speed of a journey in stages → total distance $\div$ total time, stops included; never average the speeds ({{lesson:1.12}})
Change currency with $1$ of A $= r$ of B → A to B: multiply by $r$; B to A: divide by $r$. Check the size of the answer ({{lesson:1.16}})
Percentage increase, decrease, profit or loss → $\frac{\text{change}}{\text{original}} \times 100$; for profit or loss the original is the cost price ({{lesson:1.13}})
Compound interest → $P\left(1 + \frac{r}{100}\right)^{n}$, not the same interest added each year ({{lesson:1.13}})

The same percentage change every step, the first step past a target, or the value before the change → multiply by $1 \pm \frac{r}{100}$ once per step and try whole steps; to go back, divide by it once per step ({{lesson:1.13}}, {{lesson:1.17}})
Surd in a denominator → multiply top and bottom by $\sqrt{b}$; for $a + \sqrt{b}$ use $a - \sqrt{b}$, and the other way round ({{lesson:1.18}})
